definitions.explanation: Forward movement or development in a situation, negotiation, project, or other ongoing matter. Often used in formal and news contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進展|しんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was progress in the negotiations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{進展|しんてん}⟦していない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The investigation into the case has made no progress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進展|しんてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧だったこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Thanks to technological progress, things that were previously impossible have become achievable.

notes:
USAGE:
{進展|しんてん} describes forward movement in abstract situations — negotiations, investigations, relationships, technology. It is preferred in formal and written Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進展|しんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is progress)
- {進展|しんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (there is no progress)
- {進展|しんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show progress)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{進展|しんてん} (significant progress)
- ⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な{進展|しんてん} (new development)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧ focuses on improvement and betterment (often skills or civilization). {進展|しんてん} focuses on a situation moving forward. ⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧ emphasizes growth and expansion.
